title: The House of the Undercroft
author: Beatrix Sterling
blurb: Wren Dravenmoor, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
